descriptionMarkdown: Base designed to produce 2 fully stacked green belts of all nauvis sciences, initially designed thinking i would get 50k science (when highlighting research progress) but getting 100k instead so i guess that's nice, a single drill must have 480/s or more mining speed for this design to work, there are some spaghetti shenanigans in some of these "modules" but i reliably get the desired production rate. i think this is the correct amount of labs needed to consume all science or maybe a bit more. I also tried to make the base kind of pretty. this is my first blueprint ever to be uploaded online. i left the miners and belts in since the individual modules got tweaked post building slightly . More than happy to receive constructive feedback. I wont update this anymore since it works flawlessely (almost) (NOTE: the base produces unholy amount of pollution and consumes about 6 GW (jsut put a 9GW fusion to be safe) you must have defenses setup before you start it :D)
title: Nauvis double stacked green megabase
